title: Cozy Home in the Valley- 20 min to Nashville
description:
Feel right at home here in a quiet neighborhood. Enjoy a private patio, Nintendo switch, roku tvs in all bedrooms.  
Conveniently located 20-30 mins from downtown Nashville and airport. 
This home is near the heart of Hendersonville and Goodlettsville! Places nearby include Old Hickory lake, Moss Wright park, The Streets of Indian lake, Drakes creek park, Opry Mills mall, The Grand Ol Opry, Nashville Shores, and more. 
Boat and RV parking are available.

The space
This home is located in a quiet neighborhood. Feel free to take a walk. You may have the pleasure of seeing a family of deer or turkeys walk through the property.

Guest access
Entire home is available, no shared space.

Other things to note
We will decorate for the holidays Dec 1st through Jan 2nd. If you do not want them, please let us know when you book.
